title: The Secret CFO — 'Great exercise in thinking about good governance from first principles. Best business book I've read in quite some time'
summary: The anonymous finance account read by 139,000 people — run by the former CFO of a multi-billion dollar company — posted a photo of the book and called it the best business book he has read in quite some time. Two replies in the thread said they were buying it on the strength of the recommendation.
blockquote: This is very good. Great exercise in thinking about good governance from first principles. Best business book I’ve read in quite some time.
attribution_title: Former CFO of a multi-billion dollar company
